instruction: Resume playback of the paused Interstellar trailer video

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires resuming playback of the paused video by pressing Space or clicking Play button. Uses existing is_vlc_playing metric to verify VLC is playing the Interstellar trailer file via HTTP interface status check.
metadata.scoring_breakdown: Binary: 1.0 if VLC is playing the correct file, 0.0 otherwise

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies both requirements: VLC playback state (playing vs paused) and correct file being played
Getter uses appropriate VLC HTTP interface to extract real-time playback status
Metric logic correctly parses XML status, checks state=='playing', and validates filename match
Expected filename 'Interstellar Movie - Official Trailer.mp4' matches the actual file from config setup
Complete instruction coverage: single-step task (resume playback) is fully verified by checking playing state of correct file
No postconfig needed - VLC remains open and HTTP interface remains accessible after user interaction
Robust filename matching with multiple fallback strategies (basename, endswith, path contains) handles different XML response formats
